Welcome to The Happy Herd Farm Sanctuary! 🐮💛

Nestled in Aldergrove, British Columbia, we provide a forever home for abused and abandoned farm animals, giving them a second chance at life in a safe and loving environment. Thanks to our incredible volunteers, donors, and sponsors, our rescues receive the care, food, and veterinary support they need to thrive.

📽️ Join us behind the scenes! Experience heartwarming rescue stories, touching moments, and the daily joys of sanctuary life. Watch our animals roam freely, form unlikely friendships, and finally receive the love they deserve.

🌻 Be part of the journey! Follow along and help us celebrate the beauty of farm animal rescue.

🤝 Get involved! Donate, volunteer, sponsor an animal, or book a private tour: www.happyherd.org
